Full summary: Retired the 07-24 verify-agent mutation warning via #40 relates_to resolution; discovered why it kept surfacing — this machine's sessions run the repo's dist/ via the npm-link global, and dist was stale at Jul 24 (pre-2.6.0 assemble fixes). Rebuilt dist; restart applies both the fresh server and plugin 1.24.1.
Decisions: [object Object]
Findings: warning: This machine's twining server for EVERY session is this repo's dist/ via the /opt/homebrew npm-link symlink (the launcher's npx rung resolves twining-mcp@^2.0.0 to the global install). dist/ sat stale at Jul 24 while package.json claimed 2.6.0 — sessions ran pre-2.6.0 assemble (relates_to resolutions ignored, NL-parser fabrications present) for 11 days. dist rebuilt 2026-08-04; run npm run build after any server change or pull, and restart sessions to load it. The currently-running session server still has the old code in memory — the retired 07-24 warning will stop surfacing from the NEXT session onward.; The retirement post is 01KZ740AWJ4GAY405X9MPRQ2C1 resolving 01KYB2J44XSHRXJWAVZFE1ECW4. Also still open by design: interim warning 01KZ6W5H89X8GVAWZ5QEK0SHNT (launch-server churn during review) is now stale — its restoration-pending detail completed — candidate for the same relates_to retirement next housekeeping pass.
